title: Minimum Volume Optimal Transport for Multivariate Conformal Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.14907v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimal transport (OT) enables multivariate conformal prediction (CP) to construct flexible prediction sets that reflect the underlying complex distributional geometry while retaining distribution-free coverage guarantees. Existing OT-based methods typically rely on a fixed Euclidean transport cost, which can be suboptimal in terms of the volume of prediction sets. We propose Minimum-Volume OTCP, a framework that learns a Mahalanobis ground cost to directly minimize prediction-region volume over a class of positive-definite metrics. Using a metric Brenier representation, we derive a volume-based objective that depends explicitly on the Mahalanobis cost matrix and optimize it jointly with the transport map. We establish finite-sample marginal coverage of the output prediction sets and optimality of volume metrics. translated_title: 多变量共形预测的最小体积最优传输
translated_abstract: 最优传输（OT）使多变量共形预测（CP）能够构建灵活的预测集合，这些预测集合能够反映潜在的复杂分布几何结构，同时保持无分布假设的覆盖保证。现有的基于最优传输的方法通常依赖于固定的欧几里得传输代价，这在预测集的体积方面可能是次优的。我们提出了最小体积OTCP（Minimum-Volume OTCP）框架，该框架通过学习马氏（Mahalanobis）基础代价，在一类正定度量上直接最小化预测区域的体积。利用度量Brenier表示，我们推导出了一个显式依赖于马氏代价矩阵的基于体积的目标函数，并将其与传输映射进行联合优化。我们建立了输出预测集的有限样本边际覆盖保证以及体积度量的最优性。我们进一步开发了一种个体化扩展，学习依赖于协变量的传输度量，以自适应地调整预测集的形状和方向。
tldr: 提出了最小体积OTCP框架，通过学习马氏基础代价并与传输映射联合优化，直接最小化多变量共形预测的预测区域体积，同时保持有限样本边际覆盖保证，并进一步扩展为可学习协变量相关传输度量的个体化方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes Minimum-Volume OTCP, a framework that learns a Mahalanobis ground cost jointly with the transport map to directly minimize prediction-region volume in multivariate conformal prediction, retaining finite-sample coverage guarantees and extending to covariate-dependent individualized metrics.
